prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. Silhouettes with drums and raised cups dance around a fire in a camp of tents, a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, resting flat and dark on the hill behind them, the roof empty and flat, against the night sky. Night, torchlight and smoke. Merry and blind. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
